title: Pilot Windup — KPI Action Grid & Launch Readiness Notes
content:
Purpose:
This doc captures a compact, action-oriented KPI grid and readiness checklist for the upcoming pilot (internal beta) of the new adaptive-batching routing policy. It is intended as a single-pane summary for product-ops, SRE, serving runtime, and solutions engineering to run a 2-week pilot ramp and make go/no-go decisions.

Scope:
- Pilot traffic: 5% of internal traffic, limited to canary customers and test cohorts.
- Duration: 14 days pilot, followed by a 7-day observation window.
- Systems: Hosted API + Dedicated fallback, Redwood Console monitoring, and A/B tracing hooks.

Background/context (short):
Adaptive batching promises a measurable cost drop for steady throughput workloads while preserving latency SLOs for interactive cohorts. We completed bench tests (lab) and an internal soak; the pilot will stress real routing, KV cache hit patterns, and fallback flows. Key unknowns: live prefix/cache behavior, cross-tenant QoS impact, and interactions with autoscaling.

KPI ACTION GRID (owner | baseline | green | yellow | red | immediate action):
1) End-user p95 latency (api-gen) | Owner: Lina Gomez | Baseline: 220ms | Green: <=250ms | Yellow: 250-350ms | Red: >350ms | Action: Yellow -> enable per-tenant latency cap; Red -> immediate rollback to stable routing + pager.
2) HTTP error rate (5xx) | Owner: Samir Rao | Baseline: 0.15% | Green: <=0.5% | Yellow: 0.5%-1.5% | Red: >1.5% | Action: Yellow -> reduce batch size cap, increase capacity; Red -> automatic fallback to default model variant.
3) Token cost per 1k (RU equivalent) | Owner: Jonah Patel | Baseline: $0.95 | Green: <=0.85 | Yellow: 0.85-1.05 | Red: >1.05 | Action: If Yellow/Rising -> tune quantization profile; if Red -> pause pilot expansion.
4) Cache (prefix) hit ratio | Owner: Evelyn Park | Baseline: 48% | Green: >=55% | Yellow: 40%-55% | Red: <40% | Action: Yellow -> enable extended prefix window for pilot; Red -> throttle pilot and analyze KV eviction logs.
5) Autoscaler stability (scale events per hour) | Owner: Eng infra oncall | Baseline: ~1/hr | Green: <=3/hr | Yellow: 3-6/hr | Red: >6/hr | Action: Yellow -> widen cooldown window; Red -> halt canary traffic.
6) Incident MTTR (page to resolution) | Owner: SRE lead | Baseline: 28m | Green: <=35m | Yellow: 35-60m | Red: >60m | Action: Yellow -> spin additional runbook watchers; Red -> exec incident and stop pilot.

Phased timeline and owner checkpoints:
- T-14 (pre-pilot checklist owner: Maya)
  * Confirm canary customer list and opt-in permissions.
  * Load test target scenarios in staging (traffic mix A/B/C).
  * SRE and Console alert thresholds set (see alert bundle ID: PRODOPS-4123).
  * Pager rotations and on-call coverage confirmed.

- T-3 (pilot warmup owner: Lina & Jonah)
  * Start with 1% traffic for 4 hours; confirm baseline metric alignment.
  * Run synthetic latency probes (region us-west/us-east/eu).
  * Verify tracing end-to-end with canary ids; check for sampling anomalies.

- Launch day (owner: Maya + oncall lead)
  * Expand to 5% traffic in 2x 2-hour steps: 1% -> 3% -> 5%.
  * Monitor KPI grid in the Console pulseboard (dashboard ID: pilot-windup-v1).
  * Communication: every step update to #pilot-control-room and stakeholders.

- T+1..T+7 (stabilize owner: product-ops)
  * If in Green after 48h, annotate lessons and collect targeted evals.
  * If Yellow, run mitigation playbook; document trigger root-cause for each threshold.
  * If Red at any point, run rollback runbook and convene postmortem.

Readiness checklist (must be green to proceed at T-0):
- [ ] Console dashboards live and links shared with staff.
- [ ] Alerts tested (pager and slack, test incidents executed).
- [ ] Canary customer consent recorded and rollback contacts confirmed.
- [ ] Model variant mapping verified between hosted/dedicated fallback.
- [ ] Autoscaler cooldowns set to pilot-safe values.
- [ ] Playbook owners assigned and oncall roster confirmed.

Staffflow & escalation matrix (quick):
- Business hours: product-ops first responder (Maya) -> Lina (runtime) -> Samir (infra) -> Eng SRE lead.
- Off hours: oncall pager -> SRE runbook -> escalate to CTO on sustained Red.
- Communication pattern: 0,15,30,60m cadence for Yellow; immediate for Red.

Traffic simulation scenarios to run during pilot:
- Scenario A (cold start burst): 2k concurrent short-chat requests for 30s. Validate p95 and queue depth.
- Scenario B (steady throughput): 100 RPS sustained for 2 hours to measure batching benefit/cost delta.
- Scenario C (cache-churn): randomized prompts to reduce prefix hit ratio to 10–20%, observe fallback and cost.

Go / No-go criteria (exit early on any Red trigger):
Go: sustained Green for 48 continuous hours across core KPIs; no regression in downstream customers; no repeated (>3) scale-thrashing events.
No-go: any Red trigger that cannot be mitigated within 30m or any cross-tenant QoS regression above 2x baseline.

Rollback and fallback notes:
- Rollback path: switch routing policy to "stable-routing-v4" (automated in Console). Verify fallthrough requests land on dedicated fallback cluster.
- Post-rollback steps: capture detailed traces and batch histograms, tag metrics with pilot cohort id, begin RCA.

Monitoring & data collection specifics:
- Capture token-level cost every 5m, batch-size histogram (p50/p95), prefix hit rates, p99 latency.
- Retain pilot traces for 30 days for correlation with quality regressions.
- Export a CSV snapshot every 6h to shared drive (path: shared_drives/product/product-ops/pilot-windup-data).

Open questions / risk log (to update live):
- Q1: Will per-tenant rate limiting interact with batching and cause unfair backpressure? (Owner: Lina).
- Q2: Does extended prefix window cause memory pressure in dedicated fallback at scale? (Owner: Samir).
- Risk: If cache hit ratio falls below 30% repeatedly, cost benefit evaporates and may create elevated autoscaler churn.

Post-pilot deliverables (owner tags):
- Pilot summary (1 pager) with key metrics and decision recommendation (Maya).
- Detailed RCA for any Yellow->Red transitions (SRE/Runtime owners).
- Config diff and recommended runtime knobs for rollout (Eng infra).

Immediate next steps (this week):
- Finalize canary list and legal opt-in (due T-7) - Jonah.
- Smoke alerts and test pages in production (due T-5) - Samir + SRE.
- Run the three simulation scenarios in staging and attach results (due T-3) - Lina.

Notes to reviewers: This doc is intentionally compact to be used in live ops screen-sharing during pilot windows. Add comments inline for changes to owners or thresholds. If you want a separate spreadsheet with automated threshold computations and linked charts, request GH-PR-5829 and I will export the CSV schema.

Maya Thompson
Product Ops (owner)
